Procedure Name.cell: Liu et al. (2024) Extraterrestrial Flux Glass fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
Procedure Name.value: Liu et al. (2024) Extraterrestrial Flux Glass fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1

Procedure Author.cell: Liu, Xue, Li, Wang et al.
Procedure Author.value: Liu, Xue, Li, Wang et al.

Laboratory.cell: State Key Laboratory of Lithospheric Evolution and Environmental Coevolution, IGGCAS, Beijing, China
Laboratory.value: State Key Laboratory of Lithospheric Evolution and Environmental Coevolution, IGGCAS, Beijing, China

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Liu et al. (2024) JAAS 39, 2728; Pettke et al. (2012) for LOD
Procedure Reference(s).value: Liu et al. (2024) JAAS 39, 2728; Pettke et al. (2012) for LOD

Target Material.cell: Li-borate flux fusion glass (extraterrestrial sample preparation)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Aliquot (fused Li-borate glass disc) > Spot — "Nine spot analyses ... were arranged in a grid pattern to cover the entire glass" (p.5), and compositions are reported as the mean of those spots, "fs-LA-ICP-MS (n = 9 spots)" (Table 2, p.8)

Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio.cell: Li₂B₄O₇ flux; sample:flux = 1:35 (10 mg sample + 350 mg flux)
Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio.value: Li₂B₄O₇ flux; sample:flux = 1:35 (10 mg sample + 350 mg flux)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Li-borate fusion: 350 mg Li₂B₄O₇ + 10 mg powdered sample fused in Pt-Au crucible (M4 automatic fluxer); glass surface cleaned with ethanol before LA
Sample Preparation Method.value: Li-borate fusion: 350 mg Li₂B₄O₇ + 10 mg powdered sample fused in Pt-Au crucible (M4 automatic fluxer); glass surface cleaned with ethanol before LA

Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.cell: Surface cleaning with ethanol before analysis
Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.value: Surface cleaning with ethanol before analysis

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Coverage — "Nine spot analyses ... were arranged in a grid pattern to cover the entire glass" (p.5), the grid being the test of whether the fused disc is homogeneous

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: N — the fused glass discs are prepared for XRF and then ablated directly; no imaging or screening step is described before the LA-ICP-MS spots, whose grid is laid out to cover the whole disc (p.5)

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Shanghai Chemlab GenesisGEO (high-repetition-rate fs laser, 343 nm)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Shanghai Chemlab GenesisGEO (high-repetition-rate fs laser, 343 nm)

ICP-MS Type.cell: N (ICP-MS type not stated; Agilent 8900 model named but "quadrupole" or "ICP-MS/MS" not used in paper)

Mass Resolution Setting.cell: Unit resolution (quadrupole; ICP-MS/MS mode not specified)
Mass Resolution Setting.value: Unit resolution (quadrupole; ICP-MS/MS mode not specified)

Detector Configuration.cell: Dual mode detector (30 ms / 10 ms dwell alternation)
Detector Configuration.value: Dual mode detector (30 ms / 10 ms dwell alternation)

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: 100×100 µm square (stated as 100 µm diameter spot at 1 Hz)

Laser Pulse Duration.cell: Femtosecond (exact value not stated; GenesisGEO fs laser)
Laser Pulse Duration.value: Femtosecond (exact value not stated; GenesisGEO fs laser)

Ablation Duration per Spot.cell: 45 s ablation (after 25 s gas blank; 25 s washout between analyses)
Ablation Duration per Spot.value: 45 s ablation (after 25 s gas blank; 25 s washout between analyses)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He: 0.7 l min⁻¹ (chamber) + 0.1 l min⁻¹ (cup gas)
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He: 0.7 l min⁻¹ (chamber) + 0.1 l min⁻¹ (cup gas)

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: N (gas not separately specified beyond total plasma flow)

Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.cell: Plasma gas flow: 15 l min⁻¹; Auxiliary gas: 0.85 l min⁻¹
Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.value: Plasma gas flow: 15 l min⁻¹; Auxiliary gas: 0.85 l min⁻¹

ICP Tuning.cell: Gas flows optimized via spot ablation of NIST SRM 612 to obtain maximum signal intensities while maintaining ThO/Th <0.3% and U/Th at 0.95–1.05
ICP Tuning.value: Gas flows optimized via spot ablation of NIST SRM 612 to obtain maximum signal intensities while maintaining ThO/Th <0.3% and U/Th at 0.95–1.05

Analysis Sequence.cell: Gas blank (25 s) → ablation (45 s) → washout (25 s); NIST 612 and 614 as external standards; BHVO-2 and 6 GRMs measured as unknowns
Analysis Sequence.value: Gas blank (25 s) → ablation (45 s) → washout (25 s); NIST 612 and 614 as external standards; BHVO-2 and 6 GRMs measured as unknowns

Target Species.cell: ²¹Sc, ⁵¹V, ⁵²Cr, ⁵⁹Co, ⁶⁰Ni, ⁶³Cu, ⁶⁶Zn, ⁶⁹Ga, ⁸⁵Rb, ⁸⁸Sr, ⁸⁹Y, ⁹⁰Zr, ⁹³Nb, ¹³³Cs, ¹³⁷Ba, ¹³⁹La, ¹⁴⁰Ce, ¹⁴¹Pr, ¹⁴⁶Nd, ¹⁴⁷Sm, ¹⁵³Eu, ¹⁵⁷Gd, ¹⁵⁹Tb, ¹⁶³Dy, ¹⁶⁵Ho, ¹⁶⁶Er, ¹⁶⁹Tm, ¹⁷²Yb, ¹⁷⁵Lu, ¹⁷⁸Hf, ¹⁸¹Ta, ²³²Th, ²³⁸U (32 trace elements)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Trace element concentrations per element, reported as "Mean" with a "95% CI" for each sample (Table 2, p.8: Sc, V, Cr, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ga, Rb, Sr, Y, Zr, Nb, Ba, the REE La-Lu, Hf, Ta, Th, U), against SN-ICP-MS for the same materials; relative standard deviations are reported as the precision measure (p.9)

value.member: reported as "Mean" with a "95% CI" for each sample
against SN-ICP-MS for the same materials
relative standard deviations are reported as the precision measure

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: 30 ms (most isotopes) / 10 ms (alternate; dual detector mode)

Background Count Time.cell: 25 s gas blank before each ablation
Background Count Time.value: 25 s gas blank before each ablation

Inter-Pass Data Dependency.cell: Single spot per location (45 s ablation at 1 Hz)

Number of Replicates.cell: 9 spot analyses in grid pattern for homogeneity testing; multiple analyses per fusion glass disk
Number of Replicates.value: 9 spot analyses in grid pattern for homogeneity testing; multiple analyses per fusion glass disk

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Two internal standards: Si from XRF SiO₂ (for Co, Ni, Cu, Zn); Al from XRF Al₂O₃ (for all other trace elements); non-matrix-matched external standards (NIST 612 + 614) used; fs laser minimizes matrix effects

value.value: Si from XRF SiO₂ (for Co, Ni, Cu, Zn)

Internal Standard Element.cell: Si (SiO₂ from XRF) for Co, Ni, Cu, Zn; Al (Al₂O₃ from XRF) for all other 28 trace elements

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: Femtosecond laser substantially reduces elemental fractionation and matrix effects (stated); non-matrix-matched external standards (NIST 612 + 614) used successfully with fs laser (verified by GRM accuracy assessment)

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Time-resolved signals inspected visually; flux blank contributions to pollution elements (V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U) identified and subtracted; 9-spot grid homogeneity tested before analysis
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Time-resolved signals inspected visually; flux blank contributions to pollution elements (V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U) identified and subtracted; 9-spot grid homogeneity tested before analysis

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Homogeneity index (H) applied to test element distribution; Co, Ni, Cu in high-Si glass (GSR-1) identified as near-LOD and flagged; flux blank contributions to pollution elements subtracted
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Homogeneity index (H) applied to test element distribution; Co, Ni, Cu in high-Si glass (GSR-1) identified as near-LOD and flagged; flux blank contributions to pollution elements subtracted

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank measured for 25 s before each ablation; background subtracted per isotope
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank measured for 25 s before each ablation; background subtracted per isotope

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: Applied: dual detector mode (30 ms / 10 ms dwell alternation)

value.value: dual detector mode (30 ms / 10 ms dwell alternation)

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — fs laser substantially reduces oxide and matrix interferences; flux blank contributions to V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U identified and subtracted

Interfering Species.cell: Li₂B₄O₇ flux blank contains V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U at detectable levels; subtracted as blank contribution

Interference Correction Method.cell: Flux blank subtraction: blank contribution to each pollution element (V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U) measured in procedure blanks and subtracted; LOQ for pollution elements = blank value + 10SD

value.value: blank contribution to each pollution element (V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U) measured in procedure blanks and subtracted

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: 25 s washout between analyses (25 s gas blank → 45 s ablation → 25 s washout)
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: 25 s washout between analyses (25 s gas blank → 45 s ablation → 25 s washout)

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: No post-acquisition normalization beyond IS approach (two IS elements applied element-specifically)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — each reported value is the mean of a stated count, "fs-LA-ICP-MS (n = 9 spots)" against "SN-ICP-MS (n = 5)" (Table 2, p.8), with a 95% confidence interval. No acceptance or rejection rule, and no acquired-versus-included count, is stated

Combination Method.cell: all: mean of n = 9 spots per sample — Table 2: 'Mean' with '95% CI', 'fs-LA-ICP-MS (n = 9 spots)'

value.value: mean of n = 9 spots per sample

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: NIST SRM 612 + NIST SRM 614 (non-matrix-matched external standards); self-made BHVO-2 lithium borate glass (matrix-matched) tested as alternative but NIST 612+614 found sufficient with fs laser

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: NIST SRM 612 and 614 measured as external standards within session; BHVO-2 and other GRMs as unknowns
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: NIST SRM 612 and 614 measured as external standards within session; BHVO-2 and other GRMs as unknowns

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: AC-E (granite, CRPG), GSR-1 (granite, NRCG), JB-1b (basalt, GSJ), GSR-3 (basalt, NRCG), AGV-2 (andesite, USGS), W-2A (diabase, USGS) — 6 GRMs covering mafic to felsic rock types analyzed as unknowns; also NWA14526 (lunar basalt) and NWA13190 (shergottite) compared with SN-ICP-MS

Detection Limit.cell: LODs for 32 elements in Li-borate glass BHVO-2: 0.005–23.5 µg g⁻¹ (dilution-limited; much higher than undiluted glass LODs); LODs for NIST 610: 0.007–0.45 µg g⁻¹; LOQ = 3.3 × LOD (Pettke 2012) for most elements; LOQ for pollution elements = blank + 10SD (Gold Book IUPAC)

members: LODs for 32 elements in Li-borate glass BHVO-2
value.value: 0.005–23.5 µg g⁻¹ (dilution-limited; much higher than undiluted glass LODs)

Detection Limit Method.cell: Pettke (2012) for most elements: LOD = (3.29 × √(Rbkg × DT × ...) + 2.71) / (Nan × DT × S); LOQ for pollution elements = blank value + 10SD (IUPAC Gold Book)

Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method.cell: LOQ = 3.3 × LOD per Pettke (2012) for most elements; LOQ = blank value + 10SD per IUPAC Gold Book for pollution elements (V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U) where blank contribution is significant

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: Analytical precision (RSD) within 10% for most of 32 trace elements in 6 silicate GRMs (verified by homogeneity index assessment across 9 spots per disk)

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: Analytical results within 10% of reference values for most of 32 trace elements in 6 GRMs (mafic to felsic); precision (RSD) within 10% for most elements; lunar basalt (NWA14526) and shergottite (NWA13190) results compared with SN-ICP-MS and found reliable

Additional Notes.cell: Target: bulk trace element analysis of extraterrestrial samples using only 10 mg; Li-borate flux fusion (35:1 dilution) with fs laser — first reported use of fs laser for flux fusion glass analysis; non-matrix-matched external standards demonstrated accurate with fs laser
Additional Notes.value: Target: bulk trace element analysis of extraterrestrial samples using only 10 mg; Li-borate flux fusion (35:1 dilution) with fs laser
